references.text: Phinehas, son of Eleazar, shows here his zeal for the Lord, which is the background for why he was sent as leader of the delegation in Joshua 22
The priest Phinehas was also sent out to war against the Midianites, demonstrating his role as a spiritual leader in important national matters
The concept of 'heads over thousands' (rashei alfei) mentioned here is the same leadership system established by Moses
Earlier in the same chapter it describes who was sent: Phinehas and ten chiefs, the same ones who now hear the explanation
These are the words that the descendants of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh spoke, which Phinehas and the chiefs heard and were pleased with
The expression 'it was good in their eyes' (vajiitav be'eineihem) is also used regarding David's words that pleased the people
Similar expressions for something pleasing or being good in someone's eyes are used when Pharaoh heard about Joseph's brothers
